A SEPARATE FILE from base.json on purpose: generate-ramps.mjs replaces `existing.color` wholesale (line 62), so anything hand-added to base.json's color group is destroyed by the next `pnpm generate:ramps`. Tier is decided by directory, so this is tier 1 exactly as base.json is.

50.comment: True black at 50%, the scrim. NOT a neutral ramp step: neutral.900 over neutral.900 is 1.00:1, so a scrim built from the ramp does literally nothing in dark theme. This is the one place Clara needs a colour outside its ramps, and it enters with a role rather than an appearance.
